.insight-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:end;margin-bottom:1.5rem}.insight-filters .field{min-width:11rem;flex:1}.activity-entry{border:1px solid var(--border,#d8dee7);border-radius:.5rem;margin:.8rem 0;padding:1rem}.activity-entry header{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}.activity-entry time{margin-left:auto;color:#586579}.activity-entry details{margin-top:.7rem}.activity-entry dl>div{margin-bottom:.6rem}.activity-entry dd{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.activity-entry del{color:#7b5261}.live-control,.pagination{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:1rem 0}.notification-row{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:start;padding:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid #dde3eb}.notification-row.unread{background:#eef4ff}.notification-row .content{flex:1}.notification-row time{display:block;color:#586579}.insight-actions{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}.field-errors{color:#9e2537}.dashboard-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1rem}.chart-panel{border:1px solid #d8dee7;padding:1rem;border-radius:.5rem}.chart-panel svg{width:100%;height:auto}.transfer-preview{overflow:auto;max-height:28rem}.transfer-preview table{width:100%}

.entity-picker{min-width:16rem;max-width:100%;padding:.8rem;border:1px solid #ccd5e2;border-radius:.4rem;margin:.6rem 0}.entity-picker select{width:100%;min-width:12rem}.picker-search{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:end;margin-bottom:.5rem}.picker-search input{max-width:100%}.picker-selection{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.entity-picker .pagination{gap:.5rem}.mapping-row{padding:1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dee7}.record-pager pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.record-pager td{vertical-align:top}.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
